confidence_excluded.reason: CONFIDENCE_EXACTNESS_CHECK.json: 18/18 cases show cache-filtered detections are a strict subset of fresh inference at the same floor (precision-matched, half=True on CUDA, IoU-tolerant matching). Not exact. Excluded per the predeclared rule -- not approximated silently.

search_space.note: both exact by construction of the cache (one forward pass per frame/resolution; NMS re-run per IoU value on the same pre-NMS predictions, verified by tools/oatrack/multi_nms.py).

scene_layer.status: FROZEN, UNCHANGED -- every weight/threshold/hysteresis constant kept exactly as historically copied from core.Controller (tests/test_sci_v7.py asserts equality). No retuning in this experiment.
scene_layer.causal_inputs: image stats of frame t (run_universal_acmot.analyze_visual, frozen) + tracker-reported boxes of frames < t (not GT).

what_is_new_and_calibration_selected.note: the only free parameter; SceneLayer itself is not modified.

intractability_and_factoring.measured_cost: official_sequence_stats (TrackEval HOTA, 19-alpha sweep) ~17-25s per (sequence, candidate) call on this CPU; tracking itself is ~0.2s/sequence.
intractability_and_factoring.full_joint_grid: 3 resolutions^3 levels x 3 nms^3 levels = 729 configs; at 8 calibration sequences x ~20s/seq-score, ~40 hours -- intractable within this session.
intractability_and_factoring.decision_made_before_any_trial: factor the search into two sequential exhaustive 27-config grids: STAGE 1 selects the level->resolution mapping with NMS fixed at 0.70 (Ultralytics default, a neutral predeclared choice, same value used as the 'matched static' default in the OATrack-comparison design doc); STAGE 2 fixes the Stage-1 resolution mapping and selects the level->NMS mapping. This is a tractability simplification, not a result-driven choice -- recorded here before Stage 1 runs.

oracle_gate.purpose: establish whether ANY adaptive policy could plausibly beat the single best fixed (matched-static) operating point, using an upper-bound diagnostic (best per-sequence static point in hindsight) before building an online controller.
oracle_gate.procedure: evaluate all 9 static (resolution, nms) points on all 8 calibration sequences (ByteTrack host); matched_static = argmax over the 9 points of the POOLED (all 8 seq) HOTA; oracle = mean over sequences of each sequence's own best-point HOTA (hindsight upper bound, NOT a causal policy); headroom = oracle_mean - matched_static_pooled_equivalent (computed per-sequence for the matched point too, for a fair per-sequence comparison).
oracle_gate.decision_rule: if headroom (oracle mean per-sequence HOTA - matched-static mean per-sequence HOTA) <= 0, report a null result and do NOT build/freeze an adaptive controller; if > 0, proceed to Stage 1/2 search.

cv_folds.procedure: 4 predeclared folds of 2 calibration sequences each, fixed grouping by the CALIBRATION list order (no shuffling, no selection): fold assignment is sim.CALIBRATION sliced [0:2],[2:4],[4:6],[6:8].
cv_folds.use: per-candidate robustness check: CV-mean and per-fold breakdown of delta-vs-matched-static, to avoid selecting a policy that wins only because of one sequence.

objective.definition: CV-mean(delta HOTA) = mean over the 4 folds of [ pooled-HOTA(candidate policy's tracks on that fold's 2 sequences) - pooled-HOTA(matched-static's tracks on that fold's 2 sequences) ], host=ByteTrack, official evaluator (tools/v6/eval_official.py).
objective.host_for_calibration: ByteTrack (policy calibrated once, applied unchanged to both ByteTrack and OATrack hosts at final test time -- a host-specific policy would undermine the general-layer claim).

selection_rule.primary: argmax CV-mean(delta HOTA) among the Stage-1 (then Stage-2) grid.
selection_rule.tie_break_simplicity: among candidates within 1 bootstrap-free CV standard deviation of the best CV-mean, select the one using the FEWEST distinct (resolution[,nms]) values across the 3 levels (prefers a constant/degenerate policy over a 3-way-distinct one when statistically indistinguishable).
selection_rule.null_result_handling: if the best candidate's CV-mean delta is <= 0, or the oracle gate itself showed no headroom, report a null result (no adaptive policy adopted; matched-static is the AC-MOT-free reference) rather than freezing a policy that shows no calibration evidence of benefit.
